title: Partner Portal 1.3.0
summary: Controller users, forgot password, Reset MFA and locked e-mail.

items.title: Controller users
items.body: Two new roles, Controller Admin and Controller User, create people who only sign in to a customer's Cloud Controller. They never see the portal. Their access to firewall groups is set in the controller.

items.title: Forgot password
items.body: The portal and the controller sign-in pages have a Forgot password link: a code is sent to the e-mail and the user chooses a new password.

items.title: Reset MFA
items.body: Administrators and staff can reset the two-step verification of a user from the users list, so the person registers a new device at the next sign-in.

items.title: E-mail cannot be changed
items.body: Once a user is created the e-mail is locked, because it is the sign-in name. To use another e-mail, create a new user.

items.title: Sign in with e-mail only
items.body: The sign-in pages ask for the e-mail, never a separate user name.
